title: Optional and ordinary cell updates agree
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $L$ be a finite list of cells, and let $st$ be a validation state. Folding the option-valued update over the list obtained by making every entry of $L$ present gives the same state as folding the ordinary cell update over $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$L$ is a finite list of cells
